import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+N]]
    
    # Prefix sums
    P = [0] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(N):
        P[i+1] = P[i] + A[i]
    
    INF = float('inf')
    # dp[i] = min sum of A over chosen disjoint even-length intervals in [1..i]
    dp = [0] * (N + 1)
    
    # best[parity] = min of (dp[j] - P[j]) over valid j with j % 2 == parity
    best = [INF, INF]
    best[0] = dp[0] - P[0]  # j = 0
    
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        # Option 1: don't include i in any interval
        dp[i] = dp[i-1]
        # Option 2: i is the last position of an even-length interval (length >= 2)
        if i >= 2:
            par = i % 2
            if best[par] != INF:
                cand = P[i] + best[par]
                if cand < dp[i]:
                    dp[i] = cand
        # Update best with j = i (will be used for i' >= i+2)
        val = dp[i] - P[i]
        if val < best[i % 2]:
            best[i % 2] = val
    
    total = P[N]
    answer = total - dp[N]
    print(answer)

solve()
